title: A spending cap during an open card no longer leaves a session stuck 'running'
request: Found in the live check of preview.act (the owner's goal: Claude Code's capabilities, checked live).
plan: track whether a turn is open
close open cards when the cap ends a turn
name both caps in the note

decisions.decision: an answered card leaves the session idle when its turn already ended
decisions.why: 'running' with nothing running looks like work in progress forever; any later agent message sets running again

decisions.decision: a cap closes the cards it leaves open, as denied by the app
decisions.why: after a cap the agent is gone: an Allow would run nothing and mislead the person

change: dclab-code server/engine.js (turnOpen, afterAnswer, cards closed at a cap), server/events.js (the cap note), tests/server.test.js.

findings.defect: a session stayed 'running' forever after a spending cap
findings.scenario: live session s_8672a9e929b3: the day cap ended the turn while the agent's Bash card (stop the demo server) was open; the card was answered after the end
findings.cause: an answer always set 'running' when no other card waited
findings.fix: the status after an answer is waiting, running only while a turn is open, else idle; a cap closes its open cards
findings.test: server test with both cases; each broken version fails it

findings.defect: the note blamed the session's cap when the day's cap stopped the turn
findings.scenario: the same session, $0.11 of a $1.5 session cap, the day's $3 reached
findings.cause: the SDK reports one subtype for both

findings.defect: the first version of the test hung instead of failing on broken code
findings.scenario: mutation: no card closed at the cap
findings.cause: the test waited for the card's answer with no time limit
findings.test: the mutation now fails in seconds

measurements.name: live
measurements.gate: the agent uses preview.act on a local app and a link to another site is blocked
measurements.result: typed 374, clicked, read 'Calls planned: 74.8'; the link to example.com blocked and the app stayed; $0.11

outcome: A capped session ends idle with no card left open; the preview's clicks work live.
lessons: Run each new tool live once: the cap bug showed only when a real model met a real cap mid-ask.
A mutation that makes a test hang is not a pass: bound every wait in a test.
risks: a background job's ask after a normal end leaves the session idle until the agent speaks again
